limitations: Scalar slope variance loses directional spectrum; isotropic reflected covariance is an approximation, not a guaranteed bound on real directional waves.
Positive representative matches a marginal moment; it is not exact multivariate truncation or full microfacet integration.
Separable UV coverage and limiting source/destination availability approximate their correlated joint footprint.
Mip reconstruction expression bounds second moment, not the strict support of every reconstruction phase.
One depth-guided proxy cannot reveal occluded geometry or trace secondary wave intersections.
